shipped_rows.title_o: School Climate: Historical Review, Instrument Development, and School Assessment

blind_target.evidence_quote: The School Climate Measure ( SCM ) was developed and validated in 2010 in response to a dearth of psychometrically sound school climate instruments. This study sought to further validate the SCM on a large, diverse sample of Arizona public school adolescents (N = 20,953).
